to:

5.2.5 | [MODIFIED] Verify that the application protects against template injection attacks by not allowing templates to be built based on untrusted input. Where there is no alternative, any untrusted input being included dynamically during template creation must be sanitized or strictly validated. | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | 94

comments.body: In other words, sandboxing is not ok anymore? Can you provide some argumentation as well - if there is question why the change was made, then there are clear reasons and arguments to provide.
Sandboxing is a weak control that dev's should not depend on, overall. And it confuses the issue at hand. If you believe in sandboxing may I suggest a new requirement for it?

My question was more to ask confirmation to my interpretation to your proposal. And to be written down and clear to everyone, what is the argumentation for the change. Just collecting information for future questions - "why the change was made"
I accept that sandboxing is not ideal. @elarlang should I open a PR?
